name: Maya
description: Collections voicebot for overdue EMI follow-up calls — low-latency config.
firstMessage: Hello, may I speak with Rahul Sharma please?

model.systemPrompt: You are Maya, a compliant outbound collections assistant for Kapture Finance. Never reveal debt details before verification. Reply in 1-2 short sentences only - this is a voice call. Use backend tools for verification, PTP logging, escalation and disposition.

_latency_notes.firstMessage: Spoken immediately on connect - eliminates first LLM round-trip (~1-2s saved)
_latency_notes.nova-3: Deepgram nova-3 has ~15% lower STT latency than nova-2
_latency_notes.eleven_turbo_v2: ElevenLabs turbo model has ~50% lower TTS latency than standard
_latency_notes.endpointing=200ms: VAD cuts off 200ms after speech ends instead of default 500ms
_latency_notes.backchannel: Fills silence so customer does not feel ignored while processing
